declaration.dataset_role: DEVELOPMENT; the same data E1 research and E-D6 already used; not OOS, not forward evidence, not live approval
declaration.question: With the PIT-corrected V1.1 universe and the frozen H5 / selection / entry / exit / cost / sizing, does economics plus statistical stability survive a 10 bp round-trip cost on the frozen development dataset?

dataset.binding: the E-D6 development binding, reused unchanged
dataset.confirmation_block_boundary: the next 99 files by modification time (93 symbols, PINE..QSR) hash to 4f96e04261781ed6, the E1-H5 CONFIRMATION binding; they are not part of this dataset
dataset.reader: app.backtest.strategy_e_d6.dataset.build_view symlink view under data/runtime/strategy_e/tape_view/<digest16>; E1's tape_digest over the view must equal the bound digest before and after the run
dataset.split_source: the USB-HIST-V1 split list (the same events E0 used); split_in_window for decision session D is F(D) != F(D-1) of that list, which reads split execution dates only and never session D's daily bar
dataset.spy_source: SPY pages inside the bound minute view (premarket only) and SPY close from the USB-HIST-V1 grouped files

forward_exclusion.rule: no session >= 2026-09-17 in any input, frame, trade or statistic
excluded_sources: any RVOL history extension collected after E-R1
minute pages outside the bound manifest
forward_exclusion.check: the run refuses to start if any bound file name, grid session or evaluation session is dated on or after 2026-09-17

evaluation_timeline.sessions: every XNYS grid session from index 21 (2024-10-16) to index 500 (2026-09-16) inclusive
evaluation_timeline.basis: the first decision session whose D-1 row is the first E0 eligible index (20) through the last grid session; fixed by the grid, not by outcomes

strategy.universe: app.strategy_e_v1_1.universe: daily_eligibility at D-1 without the session-D open test; premarket_row truncated at 09:24 without the 09:30 test
strategy.universe_implementation: E-R3 may call universe.premarket_row per (symbol, session) or use a batch equivalent only if it is shown equal to premarket_row on every row of the run
strategy.decision: app.strategy_e_v1_1.decision.seal then decision.execute, one seal per session
strategy.entry: exact 09:30 ET aggregate open (E-D2); a selected symbol without it is NO_TRADE_* and its slot stays empty
strategy.exit: exact 09:34 ET aggregate close (E-D3), fallback NONE

gate.source: strategy_e_backtest_rules_v1.json gate, data_quality, statistics and chronological_robustness sections, reused verbatim; evaluated by app.backtest.strategy_e_d6.metrics (scenario_summary, bootstrap_mean_ci, block_table, verdict) unchanged
gate.integrity: every frozen checksum and provenance link, the dataset binding, the prechecks below, deterministic replay and no look-ahead
gate.net_economics: COST_10BP mean session portfolio return > 0 and trade-level profit factor > 1.0
gate.chronological_robustness: positive COST_10BP mean in at least 3 of 4 blocks
gate.coverage_denominator_note: valid entries exclude selected symbols whose 09:30 entry is invalid; ENTRY_INVALID is reported in the funnel and is not a coverage failure, exactly as in E-D6

verdict_labels.E-D6 PASS — READY FOR PAPER / FORWARD: E-R3 PASS — TRADING V1.1 READY FOR FORWARD

statistics.primary_unit: one complete COST_10BP session portfolio return, no-trade sessions at 0

bootstrap.method: IID resampling with replacement of complete session portfolio returns

statistics.block_assignment: sort the 480 evaluation sessions and split into four contiguous blocks with counts differing by at most one (numpy.array_split); never by trades or outcomes
statistics.expected_block_bounds_basis: a function of the fixed 480-session timeline only; identical to E-D6 because the timeline is identical

prechecks_before_any_return: E-R1 commit 0b932e6 and E-D0..E-D6 commits are ancestors of HEAD, and the E-R2 protocol commit precedes the run
every upstream rules file loads through its own fail-closed loader; this file's canonical digest matches
manifest digest, view digest (before and after), file and symbol counts, legacy digest equal the declared dataset
daily freeze and read-set digests equal the declared values
no input dated on or after 2026-09-17
V1 reproduction: E1's unchanged code over the view reproduces 70,738 universe rows and 1,729 H5 rows
V1.1 contains every V1 row with bit-identical sealed features and an identical H5 flag
every V1.1 row absent from V1 is explained only by the removed session-D open test (A), the removed 09:30 test (B), or both; any other difference is an integrity failure
the evaluation timeline has exactly 480 sessions from 2024-10-16 to 2026-09-16
PIT poison: replacing every bar after 09:24 ET of D with noise, and dropping every later day, leaves every session's seal digest unchanged on a deterministic 40-symbol sample (E-D6 sampling rule)

structural_delta.role: DIAGNOSTIC; no return, no outcome; computed from sealed decisions

variants.A_only: V1 with the session-D grouped-daily open test removed
variants.B_only: V1 with the 09:30 minute-bar test removed

additional: no_backfill_affected_sessions (a selected entry was invalid while a not-selected candidate existed)
structural_delta.no_subgroup_returns: the replay reports no return split by A/B subgroup; the delta is never used to choose, revert or tune a rule

diagnostics.reuse: strategy_e_backtest_rules_v1.json diagnostics section (price buckets, liquidity buckets, break-even, concentration: unique symbols, top1/top5/top10, HHI, trades per symbol)
diagnostics.concentration_exclusions: NONE; ABSI and every other symbol stay in; no symbol-removed recomputation is a primary output

evidence_layers.research_h5: E1-H5 matched-control lift (observational); not a return
evidence_layers.trading_v1_e_d6: forward-incompatible historical result, E-D6 INCONCLUSIVE — STATISTICAL; preserved
evidence_layers.rule: the three are reported side by side and never pooled, chained or treated as one sample

outputs.run_id: er3-<first 12 hex of the identity digest>
outputs.trade_columns: E-D6 TRADE_COLUMNS plus universe_origin (V1, A, B, AB)

reproducibility.required: identical result digest and byte-identical runtime files across both runs

prohibitions: stop, target or partial exit additions
re-running with any change after seeing a result
